newsitem.title: UK: UK's Blair declines comment on new opinion poll.
newsitem.headline: UK's Blair declines comment on new opinion poll.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party leader Tony Blair on Wednesday declined to comment directly on a new opinion poll showing a dramatic drop in his party's lead over the ruling Conseravtives.
"There's only one (poll) that counts -- that's the one on election day," he told a news conference.
An ICM poll in Wednesday's Guardian showed Labour's lead cut to five points from 14 a week ago. London Newsroom +44-171-542-7947
